subject: Re: Pressure Sensitive Membrane - Conductive inks on sheets
body_content:
You don't often get email from ming@tg0.co.uk. Learn why this is important
Hi Giles

Thank you for the RFQ. Please find our initial assessment below. Based on this, I hope we can first get your initial feasibility feedback before deciding whether to proceed to a formal quotation.

Our proposed approach would be for TG0 to supply a complete, manufactured and sealed sensor-mat assembly incorporating TG0 sensing technology.

Proposed product specification

  • Overall dimensions: approximately 1,300 mm wide × 200 mm high

  • Pressure-sensing layout: 10 × 1 sensing grid

  • Pressure/force range: customisable, with an indicative mapped range of 0–50

  • Force threshold: customisable

  • The sensing resolution may not be required for the final application, but could be useful for identifying the contact area of an obstruction and differentiating, for example, a sharp/localised object from a wider contact surface

  • Overall thickness: approximately 3-4 mm

  • External material: industrial-grade rubber

  • Electronics: 5V line-powered ESP32 MCU with TG0 sensor ASIC

  • Communication: UART to the main console

Technical approach

The proposed construction would use conductive TPU sensing substrates in a laminated sandwich structure, encapsulated and protected by industrial-grade rubber. The intention would be to create a highly durable, sealed assembly suitable for the intended industrial environment.

Relevant product examples

  • https://vimeo.com/1219484514/98f0355a93

  • https://vimeo.com/1218339835/b3b04b4efe

Sensor sample

You are also very welcome to visit our office to see relevant sensor samples and other examples of our work.

Indicative commercial proposal

At approximately 20 units per year, the volume is significantly below our standard production MOQ, so dedicated production tooling would not be economical. We would therefore expect these units to be manufactured largely by hand and supplied as a single annual batch.

Our initial indicative pricing is £1,750 per unit × 20 units = £35,000 + VAT

  • £15,000 upfront setup/engineering fee

  • £20,000 balance payable at delivery

Estimated timeline to first delivery: approximately four months from project start and specification freeze.

Before preparing a formal quotation, it would be helpful to confirm:

  • Required sensing resolution

  • Required force/pressure measurement range and trigger threshold

  • Target product launch date

  • Required certification, environmental testing and validation standards

  • Any specific sealing, IP-rating, durability or lifecycle requirements

If the above approach looks broadly feasible from your side, we can then develop this into a formal technical and commercial quotation.

Best regards,
Ming

Ming Kong
CEO at TG0

On Thu, Sep 17, 2026 at 4:19 PM Purchasing - Sesame Access <purchasing@sesameaccess.com> wrote:
Hello, 
After seeing your  TG0 Pressure Mat
We are currently reviewing alternative suppliers for a pressure-sensitive safety mat used on the front edge of our platform lifts and would be interested in discussing whether this is within your manufacturing capabilities.
The product is a thin pressure-sensitive safety circuit that acts as an obstruction detection device. Typical dimensions are up to 1,300 mm wide x 200 mm high, with a requirement for a low-profile construction suitable for installation on the leading edge of a moving lift platform.
The existing design consists of conductive printed circuits separated by spacer features, which create a switching action when pressure is applied. The assembly is sealed within a flexible, waterproof membrane suitable for long-term operation in accessibility equipment.
We are interested in exploring either of the following options:
  • Supply of the printed conductive layers/components for assembly in-house.
  • Complete manufacture and sealing of the finished sensor mat assembly.
  • Alternative technologies that could achieve the same safety function and durability requirements.
Current annual volumes are relatively low, typically around 20 units per year, although we would be interested in understanding any MOQ production runs or cost reductions that could support increased adoption across our product range.
I have attached images of the current sensor mat system for reference. If this is an area you believe you could assist with, I would be pleased to discuss the application in more detail and provide additional drawings, specifications, and performance requirements.
I look forward to hearing from you.

Many Thanks,

 

Giles

Purchasing Manager

 

Sesame Access Systems Ltd

Unit 1, Cumberland Works

Wintersells Business Park

West Byfleet

Surrey

United Kingdom

KT14 7LF

 

Office: 01784 440088
